description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5925014743576 CIRCUIT BREAKER: Line 0001 Qty 208 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0060 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 31. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 01NN8 VB3-A5-F57; 45152 3266496. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
